Content: Which of the following can be considered a fundamental feature of parliamentary government?

A.Choice: The head of government and the head of state are unified into `text(one)` position.

B.Choice: The head of government is directly elected in a national election.

Content: Which of the following statements is NOT an argument for European Union (EU) enlargement?

A.Choice: A larger EU will have more weight in trade negotiations with the rest of the world.
